Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly interpreted the birth years of the directors. Edwin L. Marin, the director of "Henry Goes Arizona," was born in 1899, and Lina Wertmüller, the director of "The Blue Collar Worker And The Hairdresser In A Whirl Of Sex And Politics," was born in 1928. The Planner swapped these birth years in the final analysis, leading to an incorrect conclusion that Edwin L. Marin was born later than Lina Wertmüller. This error directly resulted in the wrong answer to the real-world problem.
